title: Upstream patches
summary: Changes proposed to repositories this project does not change in place, as git format-patch files: to IHE ITI VHL, for its maintainers to apply, each naming the open issue (bean) it resolves; and the QR Code Generation live-demo page for litlfred/smart-trust, made against WHO smart-trust PR 129's head.
validatorNotApplicable: git format-patch output (mail-formatted diff text), not JSON. No check applies them: `git apply --check` needs the upstream tree at the commit each patch was made against, which this repository does not hold, so the maintainers' apply is the test.
